    • drawToken

      public static boolean drawToken(Graphics2D g, Rectangle2D.Double boundingBox, double token)
      Draws a red X if the token is 1 and a green O it the token is -1. For other token values it returns false.
      Parameters:
      g - the graphics context to draw with
      boundingBox - the bouding box we are allowed to draw in
      token - the token we are potentially drawing
      Returns:
      whether or not something was drawn

    • getTicTacToeEvaluationBruteForce

      public static double getTicTacToeEvaluationBruteForce(double[][] state)
      Evaluations are 1 for player 1 wins, -1 for player 1 loses, 0 for intederminate state and -.25 for draw Copy past from copilot LLM this method is called roughly 350 times on average per iteration so we're looking at ~400 million calls for 1.2million iterations.
      Returns:
      the static evaluation of the game state

    • fastTicTacToeHashcode

      public static int fastTicTacToeHashcode(double[][] state)
      creates a hashcode for a tick tac toe board. Assumes that each element of the array is either a 1 for player 1, -1 for player two or anything else for nothing. this is to be used for fast evaluation functions using lookuptables
      Parameters:
      state - the state variable from a game state object
      Returns:
      the hashcode for static evaluation for this board.

    • getIndex

      public static int getIndex(int majRow, int majCol, int minRow, int finalMinCol, int boardSize)
      takes in information about a ultimate tick tac toe square and converts it to a linear index. this is so the entire board can be represented as a linear array for vectorization.
      Parameters:
      majRow - the index of the major row
      majCol - the index of the major column
      minRow - the index of the minor row
      finalMinCol - the index of the minor column
      Returns:
      the linear index of this spot.
